info.title: desktop-driver
info.description: Reads and drives a running desktop application from a command line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Reads and drives a desktop application that was started to be driven. The answer is the
protocol's own JSON on standard output; anything else goes to standard error.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: the endpoint file the application wrote (or STOCKSHARP_UI_ENDPOINT)

options.name: --app
options.description: the product expected to answer; defaults to what the endpoint says

options.name: --connect-timeout
options.description: how long to wait for the connection; 15 by default
